Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，The location phrase should normally come before the activity verb it describes. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 cannot directly introduce this action here; 假装 can be followed by an action to mean pretending to do it. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the referent was named in the preceding sentence and no competing person makes it unclear. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬家了，This is a completed moving event at a specific time in the past, so it needs 了 to mark completion. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”之前，改后语序正确。
“装祭拜”搭配不自然；“假装祭拜”可以表示假装进行祭拜。
孟子刚在前一句出现，此处可按近距离复现规则使用“他”。
五岁时搬家是过去完成的具体事件，需要用“了”标记完成。
